exposure: duration of indwelling bladder catheterisation (<=12 hours, 12-24 hours, 24-36 hours, >36 hours)
cohort: A total of 260 women undergoing Caesarean Section (CS) were enrolled in the study.
finding: Bladder catheterisation of <=12 hours is associated with early post-Caesarean recovery in terms of time for the first void, time to ambulate, and passage of wind, with no significant difference in UTIs, hospital stay, re-catheterisation, or SSIs.
